name: Jamaican Brown Stew Beef
note: Adjudicator KEEP upheld. Distinct browned-sugar/soy/allspice/thyme gravy braise with no starch base; not a dupe of caribbean-curry-beef-potatoes (curry+tomato+potato) nor any accepted beef (stroganoff, short ribs, chimichurri steak, meatloaf, galbi, balsamic sirloin, taco cabbage, philly). Widens the catalog with a Caribbean/Jamaican angle the accepted beef set lacks. Cross-protein watch: a Jamaican brown-stew CHICKEN or PORK candidate in another lane would be the same dish protein-swapped; none accepted yet, orchestrator merge pass to catch.
